description: IT-95 / US-07 AC3. Every card here carries annotations of unknown purpose beside recognised survey content; what counts as noise is D020 (docs/decisions/D020-noise-vs-meaningful-annotations.md), cited per mark below as `D020 §<heading>` with an optional ` -- <note>`. `expected` records the meaningful values a reader must still surface -- deliberately the fields nearest each noise mark (including 'Children of H. or wife: Total', which the initials stamp sits on), plus every field inside the r02 oval, not the whole card. Transcribed by Qitao against the scan, 2026-09-17. Excluded from `expected`: every field IT-93's manifest and D020 class as struck (FR-06), corrected (D020 'Meaningful, not FR-06 — correction': r02 Retired and Indep. Persons, r02 Other; IT-93 manifest `real_marks_r04.must_not_negate`: r04 Industry of H., '787' revised to '781') or unclassified (r01 Number of Living Rooms). Their expected value belongs to IT-93, not here.
